args.notes: Parent Jordan Kim asking via portal whether it's normal for 4yo Ava to not produce R sounds yet, and whether they should wait or seek services. Requires clinical screening/guidance before scheduling. Parent wants advice before booking anything.
args.title: Clinical question: 4yo R-sounds development concern

args.body:
Hi Jordan,

Thank you for reaching out about Ava's speech development. Questions about whether specific speech patterns are typical for a child's age are best answered by one of our speech-language pathologists.

We'd be happy to schedule a screening or evaluation to assess Ava's speech sound development and provide you with personalized guidance. One of our clinical team members will follow up with you within the next day or two to discuss next steps.

Please let us know if you have any questions in the meantime.

Cedar Kids Therapy
